result.description:
Position: Civil Engineer 
Type: Full-time 
Employer: KFM Geotech Pty Ltd 
Location: Castle Hill NSW 2154 
Salary: $80,080 p/a
About the Business: 
KFM Geotech Pty Ltd is a reputable geotechnical, environmental, and groundwater engineering consulting firm based in Castle Hill, NSW. Founded by Dr. Mohammad Hossein Bazyar, we deliver comprehensive site investigations, construction phase support, pavement design, foundation engineering, contamination assessments, and hydrogeological services to builders, developers, architects, engineers, and government clients across New South Wales. Committed to excellence, innovation, integrity, and sustainability, we prioritise high-quality, timely, and budget-conscious solutions that ensure safe, compliant, and successful development projects while fostering a collaborative and supportive workplace culture.
About the Position: 
The Civil Engineer plays a pivotal role in delivering expert geotechnical and civil engineering solutions that underpin safe and efficient construction projects at KFM Geotech Pty Ltd. This position involves conducting site investigations, providing construction-phase support, designing foundations and pavements, assessing environmental and groundwater conditions, and ensuring all deliverables meet regulatory standards and client requirements in a dynamic consulting environment.
Key Responsibilities:
•	Conduct geotechnical site investigations, soil/rock testing, and analysis to inform foundation, retaining wall, and pavement designs.
•	Provide construction-phase geotechnical support, including excavation monitoring, bearing capacity assessments, and on-site inspections.
•	Prepare detailed technical reports, drawings, and recommendations for clients, councils, and stakeholders.
•	Perform environmental and groundwater assessments, including contamination and hydrogeological evaluations.
•	Collaborate with project teams, clients, and regulatory bodies to ensure compliance with Australian standards and project timelines.
•	Contribute to project management, risk assessments, and continuous improvement of geotechnical practices.
Requirements:
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Minimum Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent).
•	Minimum 2-3 years of experience as a civil engineer, preferably in geotechnical consulting or construction.
•	Strong technical skills in geotechnical analysis, foundation design, site investigation, and report writing.
•	Proficiency with relevant software (e.g., geotechnical modelling tools) and excellent problem-solving abilities.
•	Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple priorities under pressure.
How to Apply: 
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
result.title: Civil Engineer

Australia Network Services PTY LTD is hiring a Full-time Business Analyst role in Strathfield, NSW. Apply now to be part of our team.

Requirements for this role:

Flexible hours available

2-3 years of relevant work experience required for this role

AUSTRALIA NETWORK SERVICES PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Business Analyst for our client’s ICT and business systems operations in Sydney. On a full-time basis, you will be part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team.

Title: Business Analyst, Full-time position

Salary: A$90,000.00 to A$98,000.00 plus super

Work Location: In person.

We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:



Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in business analysis, ICT systems support, or business systems operations
- Relevant qualification in Information Systems, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent
- Strong understanding of business processes, system workflows, and operational requirements
- Experience gathering, analysing, and documenting business and system requirements
- Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, or similar business systems
- Ability to prepare process documentation, user guides, operational reports, and system support materials
- Strong stakeholder communication skills and ability to work with both technical and non-technical users
- Good analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and system improvement
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team

Responsibilities

- Analyse existing business processes, ICT workflows, and operational systems to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
- Consult with internal users, clients, and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear functional system requirements.
- Prepare business requirement documents, workflow diagrams, process notes, user guides, and system documentation.
- Work closely with developers, IT support teams, and business users to ensure system requirements are clearly understood and properly implemented.
- Support system testing, user acceptance testing, issue tracking, and implementation of business system improvements.
- Review and improve user access workflows, account management processes, shared drive structures, permission controls, and business application procedures.
- Prepare operational reports, maintain accurate system records, and support data integrity across business platforms.
- Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes, staff training, and system usage guidance for business users.
- Monitor business system performance, user issues, and service requests to support reliable day-to-day operations.
- Maintain clear communication with stakeholders and provide practical solutions to improve business efficiency and system usability.
- If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position available and what will be best suited to you.
